<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if ( ! class_exists( 'WooCommerce' ) || ! class_exists( 'Starfiniti\Cart\Plugin' ) || ! Starfiniti\Cart\Plugin::instance()->is_ready() || 1 !== did_action( 'sfcart_loaded' ) ) {
    throw new RuntimeException( 'Packaged Starfiniti Cart did not initialize.' );
}
if ( ! WP_Block_Type_Registry::get_instance()->is_registered( 'starfiniti/cart-toggle' ) ) {
    throw new RuntimeException( 'Packaged cart toggle block was not registered.' );
}
file_put_contents( '/wordpress/wp-includes/css/sfcart-package-ready.css', '/* Packaged Starfiniti Cart is active. */' );
